current_rule: The shared schema validates Capability references and ontology records but has no closed Product Capability instance, contract, context-policy, realization-binding, or obligation shape.
proposed_rule: Add closed shared shapes for one source-owned Product Capability instance and its exact contracts, Context policy, realization binding, obligations, local profile, validation receipt, and digest-bound external-record manifest.
rationale: The canonical ontology must prove it can carry one real capability from business meaning to an evidence-limited system realization without centralizing the instance or inferring conformance.
migration_impact: The Define owner may author the first CAV2-D67-conforming candidate instance under cyberAlchemy-v2/define/capabilities.
The shared package will bind that local instance by exact source selection and keep the older central product node unchanged as a projection.
Existing Language and Registry Context capability records remain unmigrated and nonconforming until their owners act.
rollback_path: Remove the new Define-owned candidate package and restore the prior shared schema/profile and exact material digest; do not rewrite prior receipts or the unchanged central product projection.
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 capability owner plus Define capability owner
